verdict.rationale: Calendly documents multiple pre-built event types (one-on-one, multi-host, group) and an API/MCP tool to create new event types. A community user confirms that meeting configurations are limited per plan, which corroborates that multiple types exist. Per-type durations, locations and custom questions are not documented in the evidence. On confirmation rules, a user reports Calendly refused to add manual booking approval. Missing for 10: documented per-event-type duration, location and custom-question settings, and any confirmation/approval rules (a user reports manual confirmation is unavailable).
